achievements: Designed and built a standalone RBAC microservice (FastAPI) with fine-grained authorization APIs, including chunk-level permission filtering on Qdrant payloads for secure RAG retrieval across HR/Finance/Tech agents.
Architected a multi-source Knowledge Router exposing 2 data sources (Qdrant, LightRAG) as LLM-routable tools, eliminating the need for a separate intent classifier.
Integrated Hermes Agent with Google Calendar and Lark/Feishu to develop AI-powered tools to automate daily tasks and workflows.
Built an evaluation pipeline combining Langfuse (production tracing) and deepeval (Faithfulness, AnswerRelevancy, ConversationalGEval) against a golden dataset synthesized from internal wiki docs.
Built a personal knowledge-base chatbot using LangChain and LangGraph, following Karpathy's Wiki LLM architecture, with Chainlit as the chat interface.
Developed and maintained REST APIs for backend microservices using Java and Spring Boot, following code review and testing practices as part of a collaborative engineering team.
Designed business logic for assigned APIs, translating requirements into scalable, maintainable microservice components.
Wrote Docker configurations to containerize services, supporting consistent build and deployment across environments.
